title: Forms gateway settings
description: Operator settings of the forms module (docs/module-wiring.md#settings). Secrets are never settings (they come from the module's Secret). The forms themselves are not settings.

trust_proxy.description: Use the right-most X-Forwarded-For entry (set by Traefik) as the client address. Enable only behind a proxy that appends the client address; never when the service is directly reachable.

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Submissions per client address per minute.

x-can.risk: one address may submit more often

retention_days.description: Submissions are deleted after this many days.

cors_allowed_origins.description: Other origins whose pages may submit the forms.

x-can.risk: pages of another origin may submit the forms from a visitor's browser

x-can.not_applied: the provider needs a secret that can-core does not provision, and no installed form asks for a captcha

newsletter_consent.description: Adds an unticked checkbox named newsletter to forms (specs/069-lead-adapters). Only a ticked box lets can-core subscribe the sender.

text.description: The wording the visitor agrees to by ticking the box.

x-can.not_applied: an installed module's events go to can-core, and no webhook secret is provisioned

notify_email.description: Who gets an email for every new submission. Sent through the platform's email.send; these addresses are also what can-core allows this module to mail (unless company.yaml email.modules.forms.recipients says otherwise).

x-can.risk: this address is emailed the content of new submissions
